title: [Dev] Automation rule with pre-condition temp target not exists doesn't work as intended
body:
Created an Automation user action to Stop SMB for 30 min (Set 5,6 mmol/l for 30min). Precondition is automatically set to "Temp-target not exists".
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6558e7d8-c3cf-42dc-8cb1-be5f26212770)


Automation user action still shows all though a temp target exists. Clicking on it makes nothing happen.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0e6ceca9-58fb-4d0f-8131-40bd7114b7d9)

comments.body:
Pre condition is linked to action, not linked to the trigger (user action or any other trigger)
User action alone will always show the button (whatever pre condition attached or not on action below)

Pre-condition is only checked when when Action is triggered... So it works as expected:
- when you click click on button, then precondition is checked and nothing happen if a TT is running
- if you click on button without any TT, action will be applyed...
I see. I can see there is a work around to add a condition checking if there is an active temp target. I'll close this one. Thanks for explaining.
